verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a broad REST API covering the core accounting surface: clients, invoices, invoice profiles, payments, taxes, expenses, bills, bill vendors (beta), journal entries and seven report types. It also offers OAuth 2.0 scopes, webhooks, an official Node SDK and a Postman collection. However, several UI capabilities have no API counterpart in the evidence, so UI parity is not shown. missing for 10: API coverage of payroll, bank reconciliation/bank feeds, Bill Pay scheduling and execution, estimates, team-member management, and the full UI report set (only seven report types are exposed); also any explicit parity statement or independent hands-on corroboration.
